n: The Lord tells Joseph Smith and Sidney Rigdon to call the elders together from every direction, by letter or other means. This led to a Church conference held in Kirtland in June 1831.
If the elders come faithfully and with faith, the Lord promises to pour out his Spirit on them during the gathering.

f.w: I will pour out my Spirit

n: From the conference the elders will go into the surrounding areas to preach repentance.
Many will join the Church, giving the Saints enough strength to organize legally under the laws of the land.

f.w: according to the laws of man
f.g: Through legal organization the Church could hold property and protect its rights.

n: Legal organization would protect the Saints from enemies, help them keep God’s laws, and break the snares of those who want to destroy them.
The Saints must care for the poor and needy until the law of consecration can be fully put in place. Caring for the poor is never postponed.

f.w: visit the poor and the needy
